svg.text: The replicator's loop in the twin: scan a wire ring, read it, mold it from powder, scan the copy
left: the scan of the original (white dots: the object). middle: sites read off that scan (red) and the powder molded on them (gold, area ∝ grains).
right: the scan of the copy. Images are maximum-intensity projections of the matched field, 30–100 kHz, the plate array in open air.
scan of the original, x–y (28 mm)
shape read + powder copy, x–y (28 mm)
scan of the copy, x–y (28 mm)
scan of the original, x–z (28 mm)
shape read + powder copy, x–z (28 mm)
scan of the copy, x–z (28 mm)
12 sites read; 3000 grains in the copy. Open air, two plates of N elements; powder Ø40 µm PLA, gravity on, fallen grains sprinkled in again.
